prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore to restore a deleted episode with its cuts at its previous place, added an Undo action to the delete toast on the project Episodes page in both languages, and added backend tests.

+def _normalize_project_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> List[Episode]:
+    """Ensure active episodes for a project are ordered and numbered 1..N with no gaps or repeats."""
+    statement = (
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at)
+    )
+    episodes = list(session.exec(statement).all())
+    changed = False
+    for idx, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != idx:
+            ep.episode_order = idx
+            session.add(ep)
+            changed = True

+        session.commit()
+        for ep in episodes:
+            session.refresh(ep)

+def test_deleting_an_episode_closes_the_gap_and_keeps_numbering_contiguous(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 10},
+    ).json()
+    ep2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 2", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 10},
+    ).json()
+    ep3 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 3", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 99},
+    ).json()
+
+    assert [ep1["episode_order"], ep2["episode_order"], ep3["episode_order"]] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 2 -> goes right after Ep 2 at order 3; Ep 3 moves to 4
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 3
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 -> closes the gap: dup2 becomes 2, ep3 becomes 3
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete Ep 1 -> dup2 becomes 1, ep3 becomes 2

+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]

+def test_duplicating_is_free_and_restricted_to_workspace_members(client):
+    owner_headers = signup(client, email="owner@example.com")
+    outsider_headers = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+
+    project_id = _create_project(client, owner_headers)
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={
+            "title": "Locked Episode",
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": 1,
+            "story_summary": "Secret plot",
+        },
+    ).json()
+
+    credits_before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_headers).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    # Outsider gets 404
+    r_outsider = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=outsider_headers)
+    assert r_outsider.status_code == 404
+    assert r_outsider.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    # Non-existent episode gets 404
+    r_missing = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/duplicate", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r_missing.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    # Owner duplicates for free
+    r_dup = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_dup.status_code == 200
+    credits_after = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_headers).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert credits_after == credits_before
+
+    # Deleted episode cannot be duplicated (404)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 204
+    r_deleted = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_deleted.status_code == 404
+    assert r_deleted.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"

+def test_restore_deleted_episode_returns_it_with_cuts_at_its_previous_place(client):
+    owner_headers = signup(client, email="restorer@example.com")
+    outsider_headers = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+    project_id = _create_project(client, owner_headers)
+
+    ep1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    ).json()
+    ep2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 2", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 2, "story_summary": "Middle chapter"},
+    ).json()
+    ep3 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 3", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 3},
+    ).json()
+
+    cut1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep2["id"],
+            "cut_order": 1,
+            "script": "Ep 2 Cut 1",
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "A", "text": "Wait!"}],
+            "appearing_characters": [{"id": "c1", "name": "A"}],
+            "image_path": "cuts/ep2/c1.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+    cut2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=owner_headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep2["id"],
+            "cut_order": 2,
+            "script": "Ep 2 Cut 2",
+            "selected_layout": "single",
+            "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
+            "dialogues": [],
+            "appearing_characters": [],
+            "image_path": "cuts/ep2/c2.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 -> Ep 3 moves up to order 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=owner_headers).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=owner_headers).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=owner_headers).json() == []
+
+    # Outsider cannot restore Ep 2 (404)
+    r_outsider = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_headers)
+    assert r_outsider.status_code == 404
+    assert r_outsider.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    # Non-existent episode returns 404
+    r_missing = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r_missing.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    # Workspace member restores Ep 2 -> comes back at order 2, Ep 3 shifts down to 3
+    r_restore = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=owner_headers)
+    assert r_restore.status_code == 200, r_restore.text
+    restored = r_restore.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Middle chapter"
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=owner_headers).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=owner_headers).json()
+    assert [c["id"] for c in restored_cuts] == [cut1["id"], cut2["id"]]
+    assert [c["script"] for c in restored_cuts] == ["Ep 2 Cut 1", "Ep 2 Cut 2"]
